Method of Attack: Encrypts files on infected computers, scrambles file names, appends .pyongyan001@yahoo.com extension, drops ransom notes named #_#WhatWrongWithMyFiles#_#.rtf, and displays ransom screen
Impacted Systems: Windows computers with unpatched and outdated Internet Explorer and Flash Player
Attack Vector: Exploit kits (RIG exploit kit) distributed through malvertisements on websites exploiting vulnerabilities CVE-2016-0189 (Internet Explorer) and CVE-2015-8651 (Flash Player)
